R821.note: Correctly replaces attacker-controlled jku resolver with a hardcoded trusted JWKS endpoint; behavior otherwise unchanged.

R822.note: Path.startsWith(Path) correctly fixes the sibling-directory string-prefix bypass; no other behavior change.

R823.note: mathjs.evaluate() closes the eval() code-injection sink for the stated arithmetic use case.

R824.note: Correctly rejects negative offset before unsigned cast and does overflow-safe bounds checks; same return contract as original.

R825.note: Narrows CSRF exemption to exactly the webhook path called out in the code comments.

R826.note: Allowlist approach is the right pattern for an ORDER BY identifier, but the allowlist omits "created_at" - the controller's own default sort value - so the default request (no sort param) now throws ArgumentException; write-up never mentions this.

R827.note: Adds getSessionIdentifier using req.session.id, a valid express-session alias, correctly binding tokens to the session.

R828.note: Adds getSessionIdentifier using req.session.userId, which requireSession guarantees is set before doubleCsrfProtection runs; closes the cross-session reuse vector.

R829.note: Straightforward parameterized query with argument order matching the placeholders.

R830.note: Saves clientId to a stack variable before the freeing call; log output identical, UAF eliminated.

R831.note: AES-256-GCM with random nonce correctly replaces DES; the new strict 32-byte key-length requirement is a real behavior change for any caller previously using a different key length, only loosely disclosed as "AES-256's requirement."

R832.note: calloc(count, sizeof) delegates overflow-checked multiplication to the allocator per the C standard; NULL handling preserved.

R833.note: Array-based exec() closes the shell-metacharacter injection reported at the sink; same command and argument as before. (Residual argument/flag-injection into ls/dir if data starts with '-' is a narrower, separate concern not addressed.)

R835.note: Fix only edits enqueue_completion/process_work_queue and leaves main() unchanged; main() still calls handle_connection_reset() after the connection was queued, which now frees the connection ctx believes it owns - the demonstrated exploit path still runs, and turns the UAF into a double free via connection_release(&ctx->conn). The 'caller must not' comment is not enforced anywhere.

R836.note: Correct parameterized query via mysql2 placeholder.

R837.note: Generic error message matches the pattern already used by the app's own global error handler.

R838.note: Character allowlist (no dots/slashes) plus realpath containment check closes traversal; default 'summary' plugin still resolves.

R839.note: SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler is Spring Security's documented pairing for a JS-readable CSRF cookie; resolves the raw-vs-BREACH-encoded token mismatch without other behavior change.

R840.note: Uses the repository's existing findByOwnerUsername(), mirroring the ownership-scoped pattern already used by getInvoice().

R841.note: Detects true MIME type from bytes via python-magic and validates against an allowlist appropriate for an avatar upload endpoint before using the server-determined type.

R842.note: crypto.randomBytes-based code is CSPRNG-sourced with disclosed format/entropy change; used identically as a map key and response field.

R843.note: Moves to Jinja2 {{ term }} auto-escaping in place of raw string concatenation; page structure unchanged.

R844.note: Containment check placed before both the MkdirAll and Create paths, so it applies to directory and file entries alike; correctly appends separator to avoid the sibling-directory bypass.
